protocol.description: 20 independent frozen furnished-room 6-DOF flights. Original oracle STMD bearing, 400ms lead, and decoupled pursuit unchanged.
protocol.input: 20Hz FrameToDVS ON/OFF maps at 320x320, summed to 160x160 retinal bins
protocol.lgmd_input: DVS maps only; no target position, size, 3D range, STMD bearing, or trajectory truth
protocol.model: Retinotopic radial expansion with OFF-pathway coincidence and global feed-forward inhibition
protocol.capture_rule: Distance below 2 cm and trigger onset within prior 200 ms
protocol.split: 10 alternating training seeds and 10 alternate evaluation seeds; exploratory, not external independent validation

limitations: Alarm count remains too high for a production capture device
OFF-pathway dark-target bias may not transfer to bright targets
Parameters were developed with access to this simulation distribution
20Hz frame-sampled DVS is not asynchronous GENX320 and no embedded hardware was tested
